paragraphs.source_en: As Kazumasa made his way to the main castle to call upon the chief administrator, Hashiba Hidenaga, he felt his heart suddenly open and could not help smiling bitterly. The bold words he had spoken before Hideyoshi had sprung from his pride in his own ability to discern the great course of the realm.
